sources.name: OpenStreetMap / Overpass
sources.safe_use: Structured public POI data for cafe names, coordinates, addresses, websites, phones, and opening-hours tags.
sources.limitations: Usually lacks work-friendly attributes such as outlets, quietness, minimum order, and unlimited-time rules.

sources.name: Google Places API
sources.safe_use: API-backed place IDs, addresses, coordinates, hours, price levels, ratings, Google Maps URLs, and websites when an API key is available.
sources.limitations: Requires key, billing, and field masks; work-friendly attributes still need enrichment.

sources.name: Blogs and public articles
sources.safe_use: Source discovery and manual extraction of work-friendly claims with links and dates.
sources.limitations: Copyright and staleness risks; do not bulk-copy full article content.

sources.name: Dcard / PTT / forums
sources.safe_use: Public pages can support source-linked manual review.
sources.limitations: User-generated, potentially stale, subjective, and platform-dependent.

sources.name: Instagram / Threads
sources.limitations: No scraping, login bypass, unofficial APIs, proxies, or anti-bot circumvention.
